card.name: Turn from the usual case to exceptions
card.fires_on: Commas, 'but', 'However' and similar points right after a statement about what is usual or most common. The next words are likely to introduce an exception, such as 'in some cases' or 'there are cases'.

modes.label: Comma or 'but' after 'most/usually'
modes.description: A comma or 'but' ends a clause saying what usually happens, ahead of an exception.
